OUR INSPIRATION
That when years turn our vision dim and gray, we shall still see
beauty in the tired wrinkles of our faces and shall take comfort out
of the fact and knowledge that when we were given the opportunity
we did all we could to empower our people to exploit opportunities
and realise their full potential on the road to economic prosperity.
